```{=html}
<script>
// Pre-fill the listing filter from the home page search box (?search=...)
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("search");
  if (!q) return;
  var tries = 0;
  (function fill() {
    var input = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-filter input, input.search");
    if (!input) { if (tries++ < 20) setTimeout(fill, 100); return; }
    input.value = q;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", { bubbles: true }));
  })();
});
</script>
```
